# The book of a_cad_fee_a_later_edit_turns_into_a_us_dollar_spend.txt with its
# US dollars borrowed in a transaction written wholly in US dollars, so it keeps
# no cost basis for them. The same edit into a US dollar spend then has nothing
# to answer, as a new transaction spending those dollars has not.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_that_adds_a_disposal_is_refused.py.
